questions.question: Can you tell me a little bit about yourself and your background in computer science?
Why do you want to join our company as a Software Engineer Intern?
key_points: Company mission or tech stack alignment
Desire to learn and grow professionally

questions.question: What are your greatest strengths and how do they make you a good fit for this internship?
key_points: Relevant technical or soft skill mentioned
Practical example of the strength in action
Connection to the intern role requirements

questions.question: What is one area you are currently trying to improve or consider as your weakness?
key_points: Avoids clichés like 'I work too hard'
Shows self-awareness and active steps taken to improve

questions.question: Where do you see your career in the next three to five years?
key_points: Interest in taking on more ownership
Desire for continuous learning in software engineering
